purpose: Normalize Havenwild gameplay/editor GUI around a scalable code-generated wood/brass frame grammar plus a small set of production overlay assets.
notes: Hotbar slots are never assigned to fixed tools; the player drags inventory/tool-belt shortcuts into any slot.
The future radial menu is another presentation of the exact same hotbar bindings, never a second assignment system.
Player card, hotbar, chat, dialogue, inventory/equipment, crafting and generic windows share one scalable code-generated frame grammar.
Mana stays hidden until an authoritative mana system exists; player card reserves expansion space for future/sub-needs.
Minimap clock internals remain live code rather than baked pixels so game time can rotate/update continuously and season tinting can bind once season authority exists.
